summary: ParaZero Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 24, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a new order for its DefendAir Net Pod system from a third business unit of a Tier-1 Israeli-based global defense company. The order includes DefendAir Net Pods and dedicated engineering support for integration into an autonomous Counter-UAS system. No financial terms (price, stake, premium) or structural details were disclosed. The filing is a routine business update regarding a customer order, not a special-situation event. This is an ordinary commercial announcement; no board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory timeline is mentioned.
